description: IPC access for messenger webviews (Telegram, WhatsApp, custom shortcuts) to report unread counts to the backend
_comment: No core:default here: it pulls in core:event:default (listen/emit), and with remote.urls covering https://*/* that would hand every embedded third-party page the app's event bus — enough to listen in on unread activity and download filenames, and to emit forged shortcut-added / confirm-delete-approved events at the sidebar. The inject scripts only ever call __TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke, so the three command permissions below are all they need.
